notes.title: Lupus in Fabula release
notes.content:
[h1]Lupus in Fabula[/h1] is available as of today (July 13th), the latest version being 1.0.7.
Latest additions are stick control besides dpad gamepad navigation and 15 achievements added.

For the first week, the game is 10% off the regular price.
Enjoyeth!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29113194/ad395e4a8be14e30ebbd3f698d1e31ac8225fa3e.png[/img]
